description: Colors, completion, hover and syntax check for (CMS:…) commands in camindo CMS templates (*.cms.php)
config.language: Language of the command descriptions. Empty: the display language of VS Code (English if camindo has no such language).
config.commandsFile: JSON file or directory with the command definitions (php Core/cron/camindo.php template commands --all --out=DIR), absolute or relative to the workspace. Empty: the files shipped with the extension.
config.commandColor: Color of (CMS:…) commands, e.g. #a000a0. Empty: purple, lighter in dark themes.
config.phpColor: Color of PHP expressions inside commands ({$…}, $var), e.g. #ff8800. Empty: orange.
config.validate: Check (CMS:…) commands while typing: errors of the template compiler are underlined in red, hints in yellow.
